decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewithDesign and  Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Location Plan, Block Plan, Drawing Numbers 446 p.01- p.15, p.21, p.22A, p.23-25, p.27A, p.28A received 05/10/12 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - The southern side of the bay window shall not be glazed otherwise than with obscured glass and fixed shut  and thereafter permanently retained as such.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the drawings submitted, no development shall commence on site until a fully detailed scheme for the front boundary treatment of the site, with the maximum height of the boundary treatment being no higher than 1.2m above ground level, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the type, position, design, dimensions and materials of the boundary treatment. Thereafter the scheme shall be implemented wholly in accordance with the approved details prior to the development hereby permitted being occupied unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of the garage, summer house and rear conservatory and erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension with replacement double glazed windows and alterations to the front boundary treatment and terrace to the rear garden.
